## Cyware - Senior Software Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/cyware/jobs/4215617003)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building scalable, AI-enabled Cyber Fusion cybersecurity software at Cyware.
Delivering secure features across commercial and AWS GovCloud environments under FedRAMP and GovRAMP controls.
Senior Software Engineer building compliant AI-enabled cybersecurity platforms at Cyware
- Tech stack: AWS, Cyber Security, Django, Docker, ElasticSearch, GRPC, Kafka, Kubernetes, Microservices, MongoDB, NoSQL, Postgres, Python, RabbitMQ, RDBMS, Redis
- Build and harden Cyware’s Cyber Fusion cybersecurity platform for commercial enterprise and public-sector environments
- Develop scalable features from proposal through polished implementation, accounting for enterprise scale and high-security compliance constraints
- Build code meeting FedRAMP/GovRAMP controls, including secure coding, audit logging, RBAC, and encryption in transit and at rest
- Manage and review team code for enterprise and regulatory security standards and maintainability
- Partner with DevOps and GRC to deploy features through CI/CD pipelines across commercial and AWS GovCloud environments
- Improve software to address developer pain points
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to maintain and support production and operations of Cyware products
- Report to the Senior VP of Engineering
- U.S. Citizenship required (per 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(2)(C))
- Ability to comply with U.S. government/enterprise security standards and eligibility for security clearances
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
- 7–10+ years of Python experience
- Proficiency building efficient REST APIs with Django/Django REST Framework
- Strong software design and architecture skills, including scalable microservices, MVC, OOPS, and design patterns such as strategy and adapter
- Experience with Generative AI integrations, REST/gRPC LLM services, AI agents, and RAG pipelines
- Hands-on AWS and AWS GovCloud experience, including ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, and multi-tenant architectures

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building scalable, AI-enabled Cyber Fusion cybersecurity software at Cyware.
Delivering secure features across commercial and AWS GovCloud environments under FedRAMP and GovRAMP controls.
Senior Software Engineer building compliant AI-enabled cybersecurity platforms at Cyware
Role description:
• Build and harden Cyware’s Cyber Fusion cybersecurity platform for commercial enterprise and public-sector environments
• Develop scalable features from proposal through polished implementation, accounting for enterprise scale and high-security compliance constraints
• Build code meeting FedRAMP/GovRAMP controls, including secure coding, audit logging, RBAC, and encryption in transit and at rest
• Manage and review team code for enterprise and regulatory security standards and maintainability
• Partner with DevOps and GRC to deploy features through CI/CD pipelines across commercial and AWS GovCloud environments
• Improve software to address developer pain points
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to maintain and support production and operations of Cyware products
• Report to the Senior VP of Engineering
Role requirements:
• U.S. Citizenship required (per 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(2)(C))
• Ability to comply with U.S. government/enterprise security standards and eligibility for security clearances
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
• 7–10+ years of Python experience
• Proficiency building efficient REST APIs with Django/Django REST Framework
• Strong software design and architecture skills, including scalable microservices, MVC, OOPS, and design patterns such as strategy and adapter
• Experience with Generative AI integrations, REST/gRPC LLM services, AI agents, and RAG pipelines
• Hands-on AWS and AWS GovCloud experience, including ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, and multi-tenant architectures
• Proficiency with SAML, OAuth, PIV/CAC, FICAM, RBAC, OWASP, and secrets management aligned with FedRAMP/GovRAMP controls
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, MongoDB, RDBMS, NoSQL, Redis, Memcached, RabbitMQ, and Kafka
• Experience with unit testing, debugging, test automation, CI/CD, source version control, Git/GitHub, Docker, and Kubernetes
• Knowledge of Django scheduling frameworks or event-driven programming, Python threading limitations, and multi-process architecture
• Experience with scaled applications, scalable microservices, and building products from scratch
• Strong proficiency in data structures and algorithms and understanding of server-side templating languages
• Knowledge of authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
• Experience developing products from scratch in regulated/FedRAMP environments
Benefits:
• Comprehensive benefits package including time off, paid holidays, retirement plans, insurance coverage and much more
• Professional development opportunities
• Competitive compensation packages
• Exciting and challenging start-up culture
• Inclusive culture and commitment to diversity
Tech stack:
AWS, Cyber Security, Django, Docker, ElasticSearch, GRPC, Kafka, Kubernetes, Microservices, MongoDB, NoSQL, Postgres, Python, RabbitMQ, RDBMS, Redis
